title: Two ways to sustain the last lament
work: Symphony No. 6 in B minor “Pathétique”, Op. 74 — IV. Finale: Adagio lamentoso
question: Where do Furtwängler and the Musopen Symphony spend their time inside a slow finale of nearly equal length?
intro: Furtwängler and the Berlin Philharmonic recorded the symphony in Berlin in October–November 1938; the comparison reuses the site’s Musopen Symphony finale, whose session date is not established. The provisional map aligns Musopen’s 0–615 seconds with Furtwängler’s 0–600, excluding terminal tails, and has median chroma confidence 0.875. Local confidence falls below 0.8 in parts of the quiet music, especially around reference 330–355 seconds and the ending, so compare broader phrases rather than trusting each switching instant. Commons explicitly applies territorial PD-EU-audio to Furtwängler’s recording, but US status and the terms of the now-unavailable upstream transfer remain unestablished.

recordings.label: Musopen Symphony
recordings.note: Existing Musopen public-domain recording; session date, conductor and performing edition unidentified.

passages.label: Opening phrase lengths
passages.note: Follow the rise and release of the first broad phrase, not merely the time between the first attacks.

passages.label: Beginning a longer rise
passages.note: Compare the growth across several gestures; this quieter region has less secure automatic matching, so judge the phrase by ear.

passages.label: After the earlier crest
passages.note: Listen through the withdrawal after sustained force: an arrival can leave the phrase needing to continue.

passages.label: The later sustained span
passages.note: Compare how long the stronger sound persists before retreating, without treating either recording’s level as an absolute dynamic measurement.

passages.label: The closing decline
passages.note: Follow the remaining line through its smaller renewals and retreats. Sustained quiet notes make the later alignment less certain.

alignment.timeBasis: Absolute seconds in each supplied stream; trim ends are exclusive.

maps.scope: Complete finale excluding terminal low-level tails; no audio concatenation or resynthesis.
maps.inspection: Sixty-second path samples progress through both performances. Local confidence sampled below 0.8 at reference 40, 110–120, 150–170, 340–350, 520 and late 570–610 seconds; the especially weak 340–350 and ending regions are explicitly cautioned. Timing is not bar-aligned.
